# MagicCore ability catalog

**Generated by `python tools/magic_docs.py` from the code's `///` summaries — do not edit.**
Read this instead of the engine source to know what exists. Each line: the piece, what it is,
and (in brackets) how many scripted cards (every set) use it, with a few. Find one: `grep -rn "record Name" MagicCore`.

## Filters — which objects; scripts write them through `Is` (`Filters/`)

- **`AbilityKind(bool Triggered)`** — Consign to Memory: "target triggered ability" — an ability on the stack, triggered or activated.
- **`AllOf(Filter A, Filter B)`** — "Nontoken creature": both.
- **`AnyOf(Filter A, Filter B)`** — "Creature or planeswalker": either.
- **`Colorless`** — Eye of Ugin: "colorless Eldrazi spells", "a colorless creature card" — a card with no colour; never a player.
- **`HasKeyword(string Keyword)`** — Konstrari Charm: "creature with flying" — through s.Has, so a granted keyword counts.
- **`HasProperty(Property Property)`** — Gallia: "each other creature you control with a +1/+1 counter on it" — a yes/no property of one object.
- **`ManaValueIsChosenNumber`** — Nyota Uhura: "Whenever an opponent casts a spell with mana value equal to the chosen number" — the number the source chose as it entered…
- **`Named(string Name)`** — Andromedan Automatons: "any number of cards named Andromedan Automatons".
- **`NamedChosenName`** — Kai Winn: "a spell with the chosen name", "a source with the chosen name" — the name the source chose as it entered (ChosenName).
- **`NotFilter(Filter Inner)`** — "Noncreature", "another": not.
- **`OfColor(ManaColor Color)`** — Terminal Criticism: "that's blue or red" — one colour each, joined with |.
- **`OfController(Whose Whose)`** — Mabel: "creature you control"; Gideon the Oathless: "an opponent controls" — or the player itself.
- **`OfSubtype(string Subtype)`** — Koth: "a Plains"; Saheeli: "Thopters".
- **`OfSupertype(Supertype Supertypes)`** — Fateshaper Aspirant: "target legendary card" — any of these supertypes.
- **`OfType(CardType Types)`** — Vraska: "artifact creatures"; "artifact or enchantment" — a card of ANY of these types.
- **`StatBetween(Stat Stat, Effects.Count Min, Effects.Count Max)`** — Tetsuko: "power or toughness 1 or less"; Your Fate Ends Here: "mana value 3 or greater". Real P/T, through s.Power / s.Toughness — a…
- **`TheObject(int Id, int Incarnation)`** — A Good Day to Die: "When that creature dies this turn" — one object, this incarnation of it (CR 400.7), bound as the spell resolves…
- **`WithAttached(Filter Attachment)`** — Combadge: "another creature with a Communicator attached to it" — a permanent with an Aura or Equipment on it that the inner filter matches.

## Choices — what a player is asked

- **`ChooseAmongChoice`** — Something Worth Saving: "You may put a [Types] card from among them into your hand."
  - `Zone` (ZoneType): Where the cards are: a graveyard (mill), or exile (Uldaros' copies to cast).
  - `DeciderId` (int): Extrapolate the Impossible: "An opponent chooses one of them." Who chooses; 0 is the cards' owner.
  - `DifferentNames` (bool): Extrapolate the Impossible: "two cards … with different names" — one option per name.
  - `Filter` (Filters.Filter?): There's Coffee in that Nebula: "a Plains card or nonland permanent card with mana value 3 or less" — what…
- **`ChooseCardsFromHandChoice`** — Pick N cards from your own hand — mulligan bottoms, discard to hand size.
  - `PlayerId` (int): Whose hand.
  - `DeciderId` (int): Who chooses, if not the hand's owner — Solve for Disappointment: "You choose … from it."
  - `Types` (CardType): Only cards of these types ("a nonland permanent card"); None means any.
- **`ChooseCastChoice`** — How to cast a card in the middle of a resolution: its targets, modes, X — one legal cast each.
- **`ChooseColorChoice`** — "Choose a color." Option id = ManaColor + 1: 0 means "none" across this engine, so no answer may be 0.
  - `Colors` (ImmutableArray<ManaColor>): Dal R'El: "{R} or {G}" — the colours offered; empty is all five.
- **`ChooseCreatureToCopyChoice`** — Flesh Duplicate: "a copy of any creature on the battlefield" — anyone's, not itself. ponytail: "you may" is offered as must whenever there…
  - `Of` (Filter?): Dominion Saboteur: "any artifact or creature" — unset is a creature.
- **`ChooseFromLibraryChoice`** — "Search your library for a [Type] card" — any one of them, or none (a search may fail to find).
  - `Supertype` (Supertype): Landcycling: "a basic land card". None means any.
  - `Subtype` (string?): Sphinx's Approach: "a Sphinx creature card".
  - `DifferentNames` (bool): Fblthp: "with different names".
  - `Filter` (Filters.Filter?): Eye of Ugin: "a colorless creature card". None means any.
- **`ChooseFromLibraryTopChoice`** — Pick any of the top Count cards of your library — surveil's "put into your graveyard".
- **`ChooseHostChoice`** — An Aura entering without being cast: its controller chooses what it enchants (CR 303.4f).
- **`ChooseKeywordChoice`** — "Your choice of [keywords]" — option ids 1..n, one per keyword.
  - `NamesACard` (bool): Kai Winn: "choose a nonland card name" — answered by the AI's rule, never searched (GreedyAi).
- **`ChooseModesChoice`** — "Choose one/two —" for a triggered ability as it goes on the stack. Option ids are mode indexes.
- **`ChooseNumberChoice`** — "Pay any amount of life" — a number from 0 to Max. Option id = the number + 1: 0 means "none" across this engine, so no answer may be 0.
  - `NamesAManaValue` (bool): Nyota Uhura's number is a mana value to wait for — the AI answers by its rule, never by search.
- **`ChoosePermanentChoice`** — Pick up to one of your permanents matching a filter — "you may sacrifice a creature". Not targeting: the chooser's battlefield, filtered…
  - `Sacrifice` (bool): A sacrifice: what can't be sacrificed (Quark's Treasures) isn't offered — MagicState.CanSacrifice.
- **`ChooseTargetChoice`** — Choose one target for a triggered ability as it goes on the stack (CR 603.3d).
- **`ChooseXTargetsChoice`** — Dominion Infiltration: "Choose X target creatures your opponents control" — exactly X different ones, the candidates of its X target words…
- **`DeclareAttackerChoice`** — Attack with this creature, and at whom. One per creature that can attack.
- **`DeclareBlockerChoice`** — Block one attacker with this creature, or not. One per creature that can block something.
- **`PayToKeepChoice`** — "Counter it unless its controller pays {N}" — Yes pays. Its own type so the AI's look-ahead can pay.
- **`YesNoChoice`** — "You may …": Yes is picking the one option, No is picking none. Read by IfChosenAction.

## Events — what triggers listen for (`Turns/Triggers.cs`)

- **`AbilityActivatedEvent(int PlayerId, Cards.Card Source)`** — Kai Winn: "Whenever an opponent … activates an ability of a source with the chosen name" — every activation: ActivateAbilityAction, a…
- **`AttackedEvent(int CardId)`** — A creature was declared as an attacker — one event per attacker.
- **`AttackersDeclaredEvent(int PlayerId)`** — Attackers were declared — one event however many ("whenever you attack").
- **`BecameTappedEvent(int CardId)`** — A permanent went from untapped to tapped — raised by MagicState.Tap, every tap path (Hemmer).
- **`BecameTargetEvent(int CardId, int ByPlayerId, int ByStackObjectId)`** — A spell or ability put on the stack with this card as a target (CR 115).
- **`BlocksEvent(int CardId)`** — A creature was declared as a blocker.
- **`CombatDamageToPlayersEvent(ImmutableList<int> PlayerIds)`** — Combat damage was dealt to these players in one damage step ("one or more").
- **`CountersPutEvent(int CardId, string CounterKind, int From, int To)`** — Counters of a named kind were put on a permanent (MagicState.PutCounters) — From and To are how many it had and has.
- **`CreatureDealtDamageEvent(int CardId, int Amount)`** — A creature was dealt damage — Hexhaven Invigorator's "that many" is Amount.
- **`DiedEvent(Card LastKnown)`** — A creature or planeswalker went from the battlefield to a graveyard — as it last existed.
- **`DiscardedEvent(int PlayerId, ImmutableList<int> CardIds)`** — A player discarded these cards — one event per discard, however many cards.
- **`DrewCardEvent(int PlayerId)`** — Data, New Life: "Whenever you draw a card" — a player drew one card; raised by MagicState.Draw, once per card.
- **`EnteredBattlefieldEvent(int CardId, CardType Types = CardType.None)`** — A permanent entered the battlefield — raised by MagicState.EnterBattlefield, the one way in.
- **`FacedDilemmaEvent(int PlayerId)`** — Face a dilemma: "You face a dilemma as you choose one or more modes for a spell or ability" — one event however many, whether or not it…
- **`LeftGraveyardEvent(int PlayerId, int CardId)`** — A card left its owner's graveyard, to any zone — raised by MagicState.MoveCard, every path (Vash).
- **`LifeGainedEvent(int PlayerId)`** — Raised by Rules.Life.Gain — one per life-gain event, however much (CR 119.9).
- **`LoyaltyActivatedEvent(int PlayerId, int Cost)`** — "Whenever you activate a loyalty ability" — Cost is +N/−N, so "removed two or more" reads it.
- **`LoyaltyCountersPutEvent(int PutterId)`** — A player put loyalty counters on a planeswalker — by a cost, an effect, or its entering with them (CR 122.6).
- **`MagicEvent`** — A trigger event: its kind, the objects it is about — a permanent on the battlefield now, a dead creature as it last was, a spell wherever…
- **`PlayerDealtDamageEvent(int PlayerId, bool Combat, int SourceId, int Amount)`** — A player was dealt damage — by Rules.Damage.Deal, combat or not. The Inner Light's "you draw that many cards" is Amount — the trigger's X.
- **`SpellCastEvent(int CardId, int PlayerId, int NoncreatureSpellNumber = 0, int Copies = 0)`** — A spell was cast — raised by CastSpellAction.PutOnStack (copies are not cast, and raise none).
- **`StepBeganEvent(Step Step)`** — A step began — "at the beginning of …". Raised for the steps scripted cards trigger on.
- **`SurveilledEvent(int PlayerId)`** — A player surveilled — raised only by Surveil (MagicCore has no Scry yet; "whenever you scry" would need it to raise this too).

## Building blocks — targets, refs, counts, triggers

- **`TargetSpec(From From, Filter? Filter = null)`** — What one "target" word allows: a zone, a filter (which objects there), and the targeting rules. Checked when chosen AND again on…
  - `Optional` (bool): "Up to one target" — choosing nothing (id 0) is legal.
  - `NotThePrevious` (bool): The second of "one or two target creatures": optional, and not the first one again.
  - `PerX` (bool): Dominion Infiltration: "Choose X target creatures your opponents control" — this word X times, X as cast,…
  - `Or` (TargetSpec?): Fatehold Charm: "target spell or creature" — also legal where this one says, in its own zone. Only the outer…
  - `IfKicked` (TargetSpec?): Highly Illogical: "Counter target spell with mana value 2 or less. If this spell was kicked, instead counter…
- **`Ref(RefKind Kind, int Index = 0)`** — Who or what an effect acts on, resolved against the context at resolution: a referent ("you", "target creature", "this"), or All — every…
  - `Zone` (ZoneType?): For All: the zone — Eye of Jace: "cards in your GRAVEYARD"; Ajani: "each creature" (the battlefield).
  - `Filter` (Filter?): For All: which objects there — Ajani: "each creature except for tokens you control". None is every one.
  - `Of` (Ref?): For All: whose zone — Twisted Fates: "each creature target player controls" is Of = Target(i); "your…
  - `ManaValueIs` (Count?): For All: Engineered Explosives: "each nonland permanent with mana value equal to the number of charge…
- **`Count(int Fixed, Ref? Of = null, CountOf Kind = CountOf.Fixed, int Sign = 1)`** — A number in rules text, counted at resolution. Counting goes through Ref, so "creatures you control" means one thing everywhere. A…
  - `Per` (int): "For every three cards in your graveyard": the count divided by this, rounded down.
  - `Times` (int): Dark Matter Manipulator: "+2/+0 for every seven" — each Per counts this many.
  - `Plus` (int): Sickbay: "where X is one plus the amount of life you gained this turn" — added after the rest.
  - `CounterKind` (string?): CountersOfKind: which kind — "quest", "lore", "promotion".
- **`Trigger(EventKind On)`** — "When/Whenever [something happens]" — the kind of event, then which of its subjects (Subject: "a creature you control"), who did it (By:…
  - `Subject` (Filters.Filter?): Koth: "a Plains you control" — the event's subject (a dead creature as it last was). None: any.
  - `By` (Whose): Who did it: "you cast", "an opponent activates"; for a step, whose turn it is.
  - `ReadFrom` (ReadFrom): "When this dies", "when you cast this": read from the card itself (Triggers.Collect), never matched on the…
  - `While` (Condition?): Power 8: "whenever you attack WHILE creatures you control have total power 8 or greater" — part of the…
  - `OneOrMore` (bool): Blastoneuron: "Whenever one or more cards leave your graveyard" — at most one trigger per batch: the events…

## Vocabulary — enums

- **CountOf**: `Fixed`; `NumberOf` ("the number of [Ref]"); `GreatestPowerOf` ("the greatest power among [Ref]"); `GreatestToughnessOf` (Ghalta, the Immovable: "the greatest toughness among creatures you control"); `GreatestManaValueOf` (Hapatra: "the greatest mana value among cards in your graveyard"); `DistinctPowersOf` (Loot, the Nexus: "each different power among [Ref]"); `ColorsAmong` (Karn, Gilded Guardian: "each color among [Ref]"); `PowerOf` ("equal to its power"); `LoyaltyOf` ("equal to its loyalty"); `X` (the X paid); `CountersOn` ("+1/+1 counters on [Ref]"); `LifeYouGainedThisTurn`; `CardsYouDrewThisTurn`; `CardsYouDiscardedThisTurn`; `LoyaltyAbilitiesYouActivatedThisTurn`; `BasicLandTypesAmongLandsYouControl` (domain); `CardTypesInAllGraveyards` (Tarmogoyf); `YourSurveilsThisTurn`; `SpellsYouCastThisTurn`; `NoncreatureSpellsYouCastThisTurn` (Discovery of the Doomsayer's "if you've cast a noncreature spell this turn"); `NoncombatDamageToOpponentsLastTurn`; `NoncombatDamageToOpponentsThisTurn`; `CreaturesDiedThisTurn` (anyone's); `ChargeCountersOn` (Gardenize: "for each charge counter on [Ref]"); `CardsFromLibraryToGraveyardThisTurn` (Cruel Calculations: of the player [Ref]); `PermanentsReturnedToHandThisTurn` (Miles O'Brien: "a permanent was returned to your hand from the battlefield this turn" — of the player [Ref]); `NonlandCardsChosen` (Seasoned Cryomancer: "nonland cards [discarded] this way" — the last hand choice); `PermanentsChosen` (Genesis Device: "up to that many" — the last permanent choice (the lands sacrificed)); `TotalLoyaltyOf` (Jace, Reality Sculptor: "loyalty counters among Jaces you control"); `SubtypesAmong` (Tam: "planeswalker types among planeswalkers you control"); `DistinctNamesOf` (Strange new worlds: "the number of differently named lands you control"); `TotalPowerOf` (Power 8: "creatures you control have total power 8 or greater"); `CountersOfKind` (Anthropological Mission: "three or more quest counters on [Ref]" — Count.CounterKind); `CreatureTypesAmong` (Federation: "creature types among non-Borg creatures you control"); `AllCountersOn` (Jadzia Dax: "the number of counters on her" — every kind); `LifeTotalOf` (Live Long and Prosper: "Double your life total" — the players [Ref] names); `LifeLostThisTurnOf` (Gul Dukat: "the life that player lost this turn" — the players [Ref] names); `DilemmasFacedThisTurnBy` (Sisko: "each dilemma you've faced this turn" — the players [Ref] names)

- **EventKind**: `Entered`; `Attacked`; `AttackersDeclared`; `CombatDamageToPlayers`; `SpellCast`; `Died`; `PlayerDealtDamage`; `CreatureDealtDamage`; `StepBegan`; `Blocks`; `Surveilled`; `Discarded`; `LoyaltyCountersPut`; `BecameTarget`; `LoyaltyActivated`; `LifeGained`; `BecameTapped` (Hemmer: "whenever Hemmer becomes tapped"); `FacedDilemma` ("whenever you face a dilemma" — modes chosen for a spell or ability); `CountersPut` (a Saga's chapter: "as the number of lore counters becomes at least N" (Trigger.Chapter)); `LeftGraveyard` (Vash: "whenever a card leaves your graveyard" — MagicState.MoveCard, every path); `Drew` (Data, New Life: "whenever you draw a card" — MagicState.Draw, one per card); `AbilityActivated` (Kai Winn: "activates an ability of a source with the chosen name" — mana abilities too); `Reflexive` ("When you do": put on the stack by WhenYouDo, never raised)

- **RefKind**: `You`; `EachOpponent`; `EachPlayer`; `Target`; `ControllerOfTarget`; `OwnerOfTarget` (Clash of Elements: "its owner" — wherever the card now is); `Source`; `SourceHost` (an Aura's "enchanted creature" — what the source is attached to); `EventCard`; `EventObject` (ward: "counter it" — the spell or ability that targeted, if it is still that object); `ControllerOfEventCard` (Tetsuko, Pursuer: "that creature's controller"); `All` ("creatures you control", "cards in your graveyard": a zone's objects that match a filter); `EachTarget` (Dominion Infiltration: "for each of them" — every target chosen, those still legal); `ActivePlayer` (Peace in Our Time: "on each player's turn, that player" — whose turn it is)

- **CostSlot**: `None` (nothing to choose: "{T}", "sacrifice this"); `Sacrifice`; `Discard`; `Exile`; `Behold`; `Tap` (Station: "Tap another creature you control" — which one is the player's choice); `SecondTap` (Worf: "Tap two untapped artifacts and/or creatures" — the second one); `Return` (Beam me up: "return a creature you control to its owner's hand"); `TapSet` (Collation Trimatrix: "Tap three untapped artifact creatures you control" — the whole set (ActivateAbilityAction.TapIds))

- **EventTest**: `None`; `RemovingTwoOrMore` (Way of the Mind Sculptor: a loyalty ability that removed two or more); `Alone` (Jiang Yanggu, Yuriko: the only creature its controller has attacking); `EquipmentOrTargetsYourCreature` (Danitha, Sword of Hope: an Equipment spell, or a spell targeting your creature); `TargetsAnOpponentOrTheirCreature` (Danitha, Spear of Agony); `FirstNoncreatureSpell` (Plan for All Outcomes: numbered as it is cast); `CombatDamageFromThis` ("whenever this deals combat damage to a player"); `Noncombat` ("whenever an opponent is dealt noncombat damage")

- **From**: `Players`; `Battlefield`; `Stack` (spells: an ability on the stack is not a card); `YourGraveyard`; `AnyGraveyard` (Afterthought Sentry: "target card from a graveyard"); `Ability` (Sublime Epiphany: "target activated or triggered ability" — on the stack, not a card)

- **ManaRestriction**: `None`; `NotForSpellsFromHand` (Heartwood Crafter); `OnlyPlaneswalkerSpells` (Gideon's Memorial); `OnlyNoncreatureSpells` (Chandra, Chill of Compliance); `OnlyArtifacts` (Isolinear Processor: "only to cast an artifact spell or activate an ability of an artifact source")

- **Property**: `Player`; `Source` ("this", so !Is.Source is "another"); `EventCard` ("that creature"; !Is.EventCard is Roiling Canopy's "other"); `AttachedToSource` ("equipped/enchanted creature"); `Token`; `Copy`; `Prepared` (the creature is prepared (it has a copy of its spell in exile)); `PreparedCopy` (Codie: the copy of a prepare spell, cast from exile); `PlusOneCounter` ("with a +1/+1 counter on it"); `AnyCounter` (Dominion Supervisor: "with counters on them" — any kind (Card.HasAnyCounter)); `EnteredThisTurn`; `AttackedThisTurn`; `Attacking`; `AttackingAPlayer` (Garruk, Curse Breaker: not a planeswalker); `AttackingYou` (Jace, Reality Sculptor: "attacks you or a planeswalker you control"); `Blocking`; `DealtCombatDamage` (Ruric Thar: "as long as they haven't dealt combat damage yet"); `Tapped` (U.S.S. Excelsior: "target tapped creature")

- **ReadFrom**: `Battlefield`; `TheDyingCard` ("when this dies" — the dying card as it last existed; Subject asked of it); `ItsAttachment` ("when enchanted creature dies" — read from the Aura as it was; Subject not asked (it has left)); `TheSpellCast` (Emrakul: "when you cast this spell" — the spell on the stack; Subject asked of it)

- **ReplacedEvent**: `Damage` (Rules.Damage.Deal (and Excess)); `Counters` (MagicState.PutCounters — every kind, entering with them included); `Draw` (MagicState.Draw); `Mill` (Mill.Top)

- **Stat**: `Power`; `Toughness`; `ManaValue` (on the stack X counts (CR 202.3e))

- **Whose**: `Any`; `You`; `Opponent`

- **ZoneType**: `Hand`; `Library`; `Graveyard`; `Battlefield`; `Exile`; `Stack`; `Command` (emblems, and "until your next turn" effects that outlive their source (CR 408)); `Sideboard`; `PhasedOut`

- `Threshold` — Threshold — "as long as there are seven or more cards in your graveyard". [6: Void Extrapolator // Omit Variables, Theorix Metamage // Omit Variables, Proft, Sinister Mastermind…]
- `YouControlTwoOrMoreOtherLands` — "Enters tapped unless you control two or more other lands" (FRA's slow lands, TRK's enters-untapped lands). [5: Deserted Beach, Haunted Ridge, Overgrown Farmland…]
- `Chapter` — A Saga's chapter: "II — You gain 3 life." (Amok Time) — triggers as its lore counters reach N. [10: Amok Time, In the Pale Moonlight, The Measure of a Man…]
- `AnyColorMana` — "{T}: Add one mana of any color." — five abilities, one per colour, sharing a restriction. [3: Gideon's Memorial, Xenobotanist, Class-F Shuttlecraft]
- `BasicLandcycling` — "Basic landcycling {2} ({2}, Discard this card: Search your library for a basic land card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.)" [10: Hexhaven Battalion, Undulating Witness, Apex Witchstalker…]
- `Ward` — "Ward {N} (Whenever this creature becomes the target of a spell or ability an opponent controls, counter it unless that player pays {N}.)"… [8: Unflinching Hortimancer, Wrecking Gecko, Kwia Vigorbloom…]
- `Equip` — "Equip {N} ({N}: Attach to target creature you control. Equip only as a sorcery.)" [9: Medic's Kitesail, Hunter's Axe, Warrior's Blades…]
- `AttachedGets` — "Equipped/enchanted creature gets +P/+T." [11: Medic's Kitesail, Ferocity of the Hunt, Hunter's Axe…]
- `M` — One bullet: its target words and effects. Its text is filled in from the card. [59: Surgical Precision, Divining Duelist, Perfected Theory…]
- `ModalSpell` — "Choose one/two —" spell. The modes must match the printed bullets one for one. [32: Surgical Precision, Perfected Theory, Rise of the Deathbringer…]
- `Printed` — Names each mode with its printed bullet — and refuses a script whose count differs. [1: Tea, Earl Grey, Hot]

## Shared tokens (`MagicCore/Sets/Tokens.cs`)

- `Token` — A token's printed data: a name, a type line and what the text gives it.
- `Treasure` — "A Treasure token. (It's an artifact with '{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add one mana of any color.')" [2: Vraska, the Cutting Glare, Grand Nagus Zek]
- `SacrificeForMana` — "{T}, Sacrifice this token: Add [N] mana of any (one) color." — Treasure's and Lotus's. [3: Vraska, Soul of Stone, Vraska, the Cutting Glare, Kwia Vigorbloom]
- `CreateTreasure` — "Create a Treasure token." [5: Savvy Profiteer, Temporal Conqueror, Grand Nagus Zek…]
- `Clue` — "A Clue token. (It's an artifact with '{2}, Sacrifice this token: Draw a card.')"
- `CreateClue` — "Create a Clue token" (investigate: TRK's Cha'DIch Investigator, The Measure of a Man). [6: Starfleet Security, Commander Raffi Musiker, Constable Odo…]
- `Food` — "A Food token. (It's an artifact with '{2}, {T}, Sacrifice this token: You gain 3 life.')"
- `CreateFood` — "Create a Food token" (TRK's Neelix, Moral Support; Replicator). [2: Neelix, Moral Support, Replicator]
